The '''1986 1. divisjon''' was the 42nd completed season of top division [[association football|football]] in [[Norway]]. The season began on 27 April 1986 and ended on 19 October 1986.

22 games were played with 2 points given for wins and 1 for draws. Number eleven and twelve were relegated. The winners of the two groups of the [[1. divisjon|2. divisjon]] were promoted, as well as the winner of a series of play-off matches between the two second-placed teams in the two groups of the 2. divisjon and number ten in the 1. divisjon.

[[Lillestrøm SK]] won the league, after a slow start but later 11 consecutive wins. It was Lillestrøm's fourth title. [[Viking FK|Viking]] and [[Strømmen IF|Strømmen]] were relegated to the 2. divisjon. The league had low attendances this year.<ref>{{cite book | title = Oppslagsbok om norsk fotball | publisher = Wagner & Flust Forlag | date = 2000 | pages = 255 | isbn = 82-92228-00-4 }}</ref>

==Relegation play-offs==
The qualification matches were contested between [[Tromsø IL|Tromsø]] (10th in the 1. divisjon), [[Drøbak/Frogn IL|Drøbak/Frogn]] (2nd in the 2. divisjon - Group A), and [[FK Vidar|Vidar]] (2nd in the 2. divisjon - Group B). Tromsø won and remained in the 1. divisjon.
